item.title: “Absolutely Not”: BF Asked To Scrap His Weekend Plans So He Can Build Shelves For GF’s Friend
item.description: A guy planned a weekend getaway with a longtime friend. However, his girlfriend had already planned his weekend for him and volunteered his free time to her friend for some bookshelf building. The couple clashed when the boyfriend refused. The GF thought he should be willing to get into her and her friend's good graces. But the boyfriend saw this as a red flag and a lack of respect for him and his time.
